name: finorchestrate
description: Voice budget guardian for developer teams: a self-hosted MCP server with an autonomous guardian, MCP Apps cards and a live dashboard.

scripts.build: npm run build:card && npm run build --workspace @finorchestrate/web && npm run build --workspace @finorchestrate/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/icons && tsc -p apps/card && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
